contracts.name: Grid No. 1: Girl with a Pearl Earring
contracts.description:
Vermeer's Girl with a Pearl Earring, cut into 400 squares. Each wallet picks one square, and every pick stays sealed until the board closes, so nobody knows who else chose theirs.

A square's edition size is the number of people who picked it. An Edition of 7 means seven people picked it. A 1 of 1 means only one did. Squares nobody picks are never minted.

Vermeer, c. 1665. Mauritshuis, public domain.

contracts.name: Marfa Run Cards
contracts.description:
A free NES-style runner set in Marfa, Texas, where every run you mint is a card that keeps the whole run on-chain.

Play as a guest of the Marfa Sprite Party, jump the Judd boxes, grab burritos. Each card stores the course and every jump, and the server replays the run before it mints, so the score is the one that was played. The top score holds the **Marfa Run Crown**, a soulbound NFT that moves to whoever beats the record.

Built with [ABX](https://abx.io) on [Art Blocks](https://www.artblocks.io). The card art is an on-chain program on Base.

**Play:** [marfa-run.vercel.app](https://marfa-run.vercel.app)

contracts.name: Polyphony
contracts.description: Polyphony is my attempt to make code feel like a hand on a canvas. Six brush systems written from scratch (watercolor, dry brush, spray, pencil, stipple and pointillism) paint across four stacked surfaces, guided by a colour system that scores every fill and balances warm against cool. Each piece is painted live from its seed, and I never know how it will settle until it runs.
